g.text: Team Domain Model — Excerpt Relevant to US120 (Flight DSL Semantic Validation)
What the semantic validator checks against the domain
• FlightDesignator must be unique → S: FLIGHT_ID_NOT_UNIQUE
• Flight type must be REGULAR or CHARTER → S: FLIGHT_TYPE_INVALID
• Each FlightPlan has ≥1 FlightLeg → S: FLIGHT_MISSING_LEGS
• ArrivalInfo airport of leg n = DepartureInfo airport of leg n+1
• Arrival time of leg n < departure time of leg n+1
• No airport visited twice → S: ROUTE_AIRPORT_REPEATED
• Waypoint start ≠ Waypoint end → S: SEGMENT_START_EQUALS_END
Subset extracted from the team's conceptual Domain Model
This excerpt is the *target* model that the Flight DSL describes —
persistence; it operates on the AST (see class diagram) whose nodes
mirror the concepts shown here one-to-one. Implementation status of
each class is independent of US120.
